parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.06 experiment (1.012030) as it was slightly worse than my previous best (1.010544). It seems the increased capacity from ASPECT_RATIO=64 requires a lower learning rate than 0.06 to maintain optimal convergence. Reverting to ASPECT_RATIO=64, DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05. Next, I'll try a slightly higher ASPECT_RATIO to see if width scaling continues.
parsed.description: Testing if increasing width (ASPECT_RATIO) further improves val_bpb on the DEPTH=6, LR=0.05 branch.
